id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

facility.description: The {@link Facility} the {@link ReliabilityAsset} belongs to.

assetClass.description: The {@link AssetClass} the {@link ReliabilityAsset} belongs to.

newSensorMap.description: The new {@link Sensor}s that the {@link ReliabilityAsset} will be associated to. This field is initially empty.

potentialNewExpectedSensors.description: The custom {@link ExpectedSensor}s added by the user. This field is initially empty.

existingSensorRelationToExpectedSensor.description:
Map of {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation} ids to {@link ExpectedSensor}s from the currently existing
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s on this asset.

Used to evaluate whether an existing sensor relation has been deleted, or if it has been modified.

sensorRelationMap.description:
Map of {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s which corresponds to the current mapping of the page.
This is initially set from {@link ReliabilityAsset#currentSensorRelations}.

Stored as an Immutable.js OrderedMap to preserve order in grid when adding elements. If changing this field,
always use Immutable.js OrderedMap methods to ensure order is preserved.

availableExpectedSensors.description: Map of the available {@link ExpectedSensor}s to be linked.

llmSuggestedExpectedSensors.description:
Map of the LLM suggested {@link ExpectedSensor}s for each {@link Sensor}.
Maps sensor ID to an array of matched expected sensor names.

modifiedExistingSensorRelation.description:
A flag that indicates whether the user has modified an existing sensor relation.

It is only set when trying to save the sensor mappings, and is used to know which
warning message to display to the user.

existsUnmappedSensors.description:
A flag that indicates that there are some expected sensors that are not mapped.

It is only set when trying to save the sensor mappings, and is used to know which
warning message to display to the user.

shouldMarkAsComplete.description:
A flag that indicates that the sensor mapping status should be set to complete on clicking the "Proceed Anyway"
button in the Save Sensor Mapping Warning Modal. It is only set and used when the warning modal is shown.

assetName.description: The name of the asset that the sensor mapping is for.

parsableDiagrams.description: The collection of {@link ParsableDiagram}s associated with Asset {@link ReliabilityAsset} .

displaySensorMappingStatus.description: Stores the displaySensorMappingStatus of the asset, if the asset class is updated while on the Sensor Mapping page.

title:
Application state for sensor mapping. Acts as a singleton; there is only one instance of this application state
with a set ID "Reliability.SensorMappingApplicationState".
name: SensorMappingApplicationState
